latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of china-company-search-wendaoyun.

- Provides comprehensive enterprise information search via WenDaoYun API.
- Supports searching and listing enterprises, with user confirmation before showing details.
- Implements endpoints for business risk, financial data, penalties, judicial info, and more.
- API Key authentication with clear setup and usage instructions.
- Displays monetary amounts in yuan (with conversion from fen) and handles null values as "未知".
- Limits search results to top 5 per page, with guidance for further results.
